_doc: Headline-theorem registry. research/tools/claims.py validates every name against OddPerfect/ sources and the import graph of OddPerfect.lean, then regenerates research/CLAIMS.md. Classes: REPLAY (formalizes a published result or a stated consequence), CANDIDATE-NEW (priority unresolved; requires a literature check before a novelty claim), REDUCTION (conditional / bookkeeping implication), LIBRARY (true but does not change BRANCH_MAP or FLOOR_CEILING). 'branch' refers to BRANCH_MAP node ids.

claims.name: euler_form
claims.statement: Every odd perfect N is q^a m^2 with q prime, q ∤ m, q ≡ a ≡ 1 (mod 4).

claims.name: not_dvd_105_of_odd_perfect
claims.statement: 105 does not divide an odd perfect number.
claims.literature: Sylvester (1888)

claims.name: steuerwald
claims.statement: Not every non-Euler exponent equals 2.
claims.literature: Steuerwald (1937)

claims.name: sigmaEdge_reachable
claims.statement: The divisor-sum graph on the prime support of a perfect number is strongly connected.
claims.literature: folklore; Zhu–Li 2026 preprint (valuation networks)

claims.name: dickson_finite
claims.statement: For fixed k, finitely many odd perfect N have ω(N) ≤ k (explicit bound).
claims.literature: Dickson (1913); Nielsen (2003) N < 2^(4^k)

claims.name: ten_pow_three_hundred_lt_of_odd_perfect
claims.literature: Brent–Cohen–te Riele (1991); frontier 10^1500 (Ochem–Rao 2012)

claims.name: six_le_distinct_prime_factor_count
claims.literature: Gradshtein; frontier ω ≥ 10 (Nielsen 2015)

claims.name: thirty_seven_le_total_prime_factor_count
claims.literature: Iannucci–Sorli (2003); frontier Ω ≥ 101 (Ochem–Rao 2012)

claims.name: sharpened_cyclotomic_prime_factor_count
claims.literature: Pure (ω, Ω) slope 21/8 is weaker than Clayton–Hansen (Integers 2023, 99/37) and Zelinsky (Integers 2021, 66/25 and 302/113), stronger than Ochem–Rao (Math. Comp. 2014, 18/7); NO-PRIOR-FOUND for the explicit +11|L₂| term (literature-checker 2026-11-28).

claims.name: exists_componentIndex_cardFactors_add_six_le
claims.statement: Some component index i_p satisfies Ω(i_p) + 6 ≤ Ω(N).
claims.literature: none found; relative drop does not bound any parameter (NO_GO §1)

claims.name: not_existsOddPerfect_of_componentIndex_multiplicity_cap
claims.statement: A uniform cap Ω(i_p) ≤ K plus emptiness below a doubly-exponential bound implies no OPN.
claims.literature: Dris–Luca style; see NO_GO §1

claims.name: toth_odd_pair_four_iff
claims.statement: For an odd multiplier x > 1 and ω(n) ≤ 4, the unique Tóth pair (n,x) is (9018009,22021).
claims.literature: Yang–Togbé (2023)

claims.name: linear_euler_unique_q_source_and_bound
claims.statement: At a = 1, a unique prime r₀ | m has q ∥ σ(r₀^(2e₀)); also 2q < 3 r₀^(2e₀).
claims.literature: NO-PRIOR-FOUND for exact bundle with 2q < 3 r₀^(2e₀), but elementary consequence of q ∥ σ(m²) (BDZ 2013; Dris arXiv:2202.08116; Gallardo 2022) and σ(r₀^(2e₀)) < (3/2) r₀^(2e₀) (literature-checker 2026-11-28).

claims.name: universal_half_succ_index_gcd_square_parametrization
claims.statement: At a = 1: (q+1)/2 = g h₀², i_q = g u₀², m = g h₀ u₀.
claims.literature: Elementary k = 1 specialization of Dris's GH = I² GCD framework (arXiv:2202.08116; Octogon Math. Mag. 2022) with coprime LCM split (literature-checker 2026-11-28).

claims.name: linear_euler_unique_source_right_forcing
claims.statement: At a = 1 (arbitrary g ≥ 1), the unique q-source r₀ satisfies r₀ ∤ m_L, r₀ ∣ m_R, r₀ ∣ u₀, v_{r₀}((q+1)/2) < v_{r₀}(m) < v_{r₀}(i_q), and W_R σ(m_L²) = g u₀², discharging the r₀ ∣ m_R guard in right-source peeling unconditionally.
claims.literature: NO-PRIOR-FOUND for unconditional r₀ ∤ m_L (equivalently r₀ ∣ u₀ = J, v_{r₀}(q+1) < v_{r₀}(m), v_{r₀}((q+1)/2) < v_{r₀}(i_q), and σ(m_L²) ∣ i_q across A1). Builds on Dris's k = 1 GH = I² parametrization (arXiv:2202.08116; Octogon Math. Mag. 2022) and q ∥ σ(m²) uniqueness (BDZ 2013; Dris 2022; Gallardo, Integers 2022). Searched arXiv, Ochem, Nielsen, Integers, Math. Comp., Fibonacci Quart., Zelinsky, Clayton–Hansen, Hirakawa (2309.17084), Ochem–Zelinsky (2607.19746), FNO (2012), Chen–Chen (2014), Acquaah–Konyagin (2012), Yamada, DHP (1975), Steuerwald, formal-conjectures, ATLAS (literature-checker 2026-11-28).

claims.name: linear_euler_right_branch_structure
claims.statement: At a = 1 (arbitrary g ≥ 1), r₀ = 3 ⇒ q ≡ 1 (mod 12), and on Branch R1 (r₀ ∣ g_R ⇔ r₀ ∣ (q+1)/2): r₀ ≡ 1 (mod 4), q is non-Fermat (4ℓ ∣ q − 1, ℓ ∣ 2e₀ + 1, ℓ ≠ r₀), A < r₀^(v_{r₀}(I)), q < 2 r₀^(v_{r₀}(I)) (doubled when Odd k_R), k_R ≤ 2b (3 k_R ≤ 2 e₀), and b = 1 ⇒ k_R = 1.
claims.literature: Claim 1 (r₀ ≡ 1 mod 4) is REPLAY of classical quadratic reciprocity (cf. Kanold 1941) and already locally proved in OddPerfect/Reciprocity.lean::not_dvd_sigma_even_of_dvd_succ. NO-PRIOR-FOUND for Claims 2–5 (non-Fermat 4ℓ ∣ q − 1, sharp A < r₀^(v_{r₀}(I)), valuation gap k_R ≤ 2b, and b = 1 ⇒ k_R = 1 on Branch R1) across arXiv, Integers, Math. Comp., Fibonacci Quart., Dris, Chen–Chen, BDZ, Gallardo, Acquaah–Konyagin, Ochem–Rao, Zelinsky, Yamada, Steuerwald, Kanold, DHP, Cohen–Sorli, Nielsen, formal-conjectures, ATLAS (literature-checker 2026-11-28).

claims.name: linear_euler_coprime_half_succ_quotient_system
claims.statement: On the coprime half-successor sub-branch: u² = W σ(h²) and σ(u²) = W(2h² − 1).
claims.literature: NO-PRIOR-FOUND for the coupled W-quotient system; coprime condition g = 1 matches Dris G = 1 ⇔ i_q = u² (arXiv:2202.08116), and W = 1 connects to Chen–Chen (2014) and Ljunggren (1943) (literature-checker 2026-11-28).

claims.name: sixth_power_free_euler_exponent_one
claims.statement: A sixth-power-free OPN has Euler exponent 1 (other exponents 2 or 4).
claims.literature: Corollary of Fletcher–Nielsen–Ochem: 3 is excluded, and an Euler exponent of 5 would force 3.

claims.name: sixth_power_or_large_support
claims.literature: weaker than Fletcher–Nielsen–Ochem (least prime > 10^8)

claims.name: sixthPowerFree_total_prime_factor_count
claims.statement: Sixth-power-free ⇒ Ω(N) ≥ 1179.
claims.literature: floor without ceiling (NO_GO §3)

claims.name: sixth_power_free_square_output_capacity
claims.statement: With S square sources, U of them outside 1 mod 5 and Q quartic sources congruent to 1 mod 3, 10S ≤ 19Q + 5U + 10.
claims.literature: NO-PRIOR-FOUND (searched arXiv, Integers, Math. Comp., Fibonacci Quart., Ochem's page, FNO 2012, Zelinsky 2021, Clayton–Hansen 2023, Ochem–Zelinsky 2026; literature-checker 2026-11-28).

claims.name: quartic_chain_mod_five_target_reuse
claims.statement: On sixth-power-free N, k quartic-to-square chains reaching D_all distinct non-Euler targets satisfy per-residue mod-5 disjoint prime-image bounds and sharp 5 D_all ≥ 4k − 2 (hence 5 D_all ≥ 3k − 2; does not close A1_SPF).
claims.literature: NO-PRIOR-FOUND for Φ₃(Φ₅(w)) = (w²−w+1)(w⁶+3w⁵+5w⁴+6w³+7w²+6w+3) mod-5 disjointness or target-reuse bounds 5 D_all ≥ 4k − 2 (and 5 D_all ≥ 3k − 2, 4 D_all ≥ 2k − 1) on sixth-power-free quartic-to-square chains (searched arXiv, Integers, Math. Comp., Fibonacci Quart., Ochem's page, Pace Nielsen/BYU, FNO 2012, Zelinsky 2021, Clayton–Hansen 2023, Ochem–Zelinsky 2026, Hirakawa 2024, McDaniel, Hagis, Yamada, Chen–Chen, Dris, formal-conjectures, ATLAS; literature-checker 2026-11-28).

claims.name: no_high_square_count_of_all_one_mod_five
claims.statement: No sixth-power-free candidate has U = 0 and 2Q ≤ S in the preceding notation.
claims.literature: NO-PRIOR-FOUND (consequence of 10S ≤ 19Q + 5U + 10 and Q ≥ 80; searched FNO 2012, arXiv, Integers, Math. Comp., Ochem's page; literature-checker 2026-11-28).

claims.name: sixth_power_free_oneModThreeLarge_ge_80
claims.statement: Sixth-power-free ⇒ |Q₁₃| ≥ 80 and 2ω ≤ 11|Q₁₃| + 11.
claims.literature: count inequality; LP still unbounded (NO_GO §4)

claims.name: two_le_largeSources_of_three_free
claims.statement: 3 ∤ N ⇒ at least two non-Euler primes r ≠ 3 have exponent ≥ 4.
claims.literature: Ochem–Zelinsky §2 (arXiv:2607.19746) for one exceptional even exponent, Steuerwald for zero. Alternative Lean derivation.

claims.name: euler_index_not_square_of_exponent_gt_one
claims.statement: For a > 1 the Euler index σ(m²)/q^a is not a square.

claims.name: high_euler_half_sum_not_square_of_prime_power_fermat
claims.statement: PrimePowerFermatObstruction ⇒ for all a > 1 (prime and composite half-length d = (a+1)/2), (q^d + 1)/2 is nonsquare and |oddValuationPrimes I| ≥ 2 (unifying IQ_SQUARE, IQ_PRIME_SQUARE, and Subcase A of IQ_MULTI).
claims.literature: Conditional replay of Hirakawa (Indag. Math. 35(2) 2024, 282–287, Thm. 1.1(ii) & Lemma 2.5), Bennett–Skinner (Canad. J. Math. 56(1) 2004, 23–54, Prop. 8.1), and Ivorra (Acta Arith. 108(4) 2003, 327–338, Thm. 2(b)); unconditional elementary composite-d reduction (half_pow_succ_square_forces_minFac_fermat_witness) strengthens Gallardo (Integers 22 2022, #A58, Prop. 4) (literature-checker 2026-11-28).

claims.name: two_odd_valuations_nonsquare_half_sum_forces_prime_half_length
claims.statement: Unconditionally, if a > 1, |oddValuationPrimes I| = 2 (I = ℓ₁ ℓ₂ t²), and (q^d + 1)/2 is nonsquare, then d = (a+1)/2 is prime (combining with PrimePowerFermatObstruction in two_odd_valuations_forces_prime_half_length_of_prime_power_fermat).
claims.literature: NO-PRIOR-FOUND in Hirakawa (2024) or other surveyed sources; note Gallardo (Integers 22 2022, #A58, Prop. 5) claims ω(d₂) = 2 ∧ gcd(d₂, S) > 1 is impossible for a > 1 and requires direct PDF verification before any novelty claim (literature-checker 2026-11-28).

claims.name: euler_index_ne_prime_mul_square_of_fermat_obstruction
claims.statement: ExceptionalFermatObstruction ⇒ for a > 1 the Euler index is not ℓ t².
claims.literature: Hirakawa; hypothesis needs modular methods (NO_GO §2)

claims.name: exceptional_index_size_gt_ten_pow_740
claims.statement: On I = ℓ t² with a > 1, N > 10^740.
claims.literature: floor without ceiling

claims.name: component_prime_power_index_euler_only_and_septuple_lift
claims.statement: A prime-power component index i_r = p^j occurs only at r = q, with j ≥ 36207 (and for even j: a = 1, ≥ 7 repunit bases, j ≥ 9699688, i_q > 10^145495320).
claims.literature: STRONGER-THAN Chen–Chen (2014, Colloq. Math. 136), BDZ (2013), and Dris–Luca (2016) on even-j/general lift; note r = q alone is an immediate corollary of 2 ∥ i_r + Dris–Luca i_r > 5, and odd j is covered externally by Hirakawa (2024) (literature-checker 2026-11-28).

claims.name: even_prime_power_component_size_gt_ten_pow_353234555955090756
claims.statement: i_q = p^(2u) forces ≥ 13 repunit bases, 2u ≥ 1.3·10^16 and N > 10^(3.5·10^17).
claims.literature: floor without ceiling (NO_GO §3)

claims.name: even_prime_power_component_base_lt_six_pow
claims.statement: i_q = p^(2u) ⇒ p < 6^u (Pell–Padé).
claims.literature: NO-PRIOR-FOUND (searched arXiv, Ochem, Nielsen, Integers, Math. Comp., Fibonacci Quart., Chen–Chen 2014, BDZ 2013, Dris–Luca 2016, Yamada; ceiling on p in terms of u, asymptotically weaker than even_index_base_subexponential for u ≥ 34; literature-checker 2026-11-28).

claims.name: even_index_base_subexponential
claims.literature: NO-PRIOR-FOUND (searched arXiv, Ochem, Nielsen, Integers, Math. Comp., Fibonacci Quart., Chen–Chen 2014, BDZ 2013, Dris–Luca 2016, Yamada; ceiling on p in terms of u, not u in terms of p; literature-checker 2026-11-28).

claims.name: finite_odd_nearPerfect_of_bounded_prime_count
claims.statement: Finitely many odd near-perfect numbers with ω ≤ k.
claims.literature: Adajar (2016 UP Diliman M.S. thesis; 2019 ZetaValue abstract), attributed in Gumaru–Casuco–Bernal (2018, Pure Appl. Math. J. 7(5), Thm. 3.4.1); independent effective prefix product-gap proof (literature-checker 2026-11-28).
